title: Harmful Content Generation in Text-to-Image Models: Capabilities and Moderation Limitations
title_zh: 文本-to-图像生成模型：能力与管控限制

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image generative models have achieved remarkable capabilities in producing photorealistic images, but raise concerns about misuse for generating harmful content. While safety mechanisms exist, systematic evaluations of their effectiveness against realistic attacks remain limited. This paper presents a comprehensive assessment of harmful content generation across modern text-to-image models using an automated pipeline that transforms legitimate news captions into unsafe prompts targeting sexually explicit content, violent imagery, harmful stereotypes, self-harm, and hate speech. We evaluate five open text-to-image models, including standard models with built-in safety mechanisms and community fine-tuned variants that bypass content restrictions. Our human evaluation of 1,500 generated images reveals that models produce harmful content at concerning rates: 89.2% for gore-related prompts, 47.6% for sexually explicit content, and 43.6% for harmful stereotypes. Hate speech prompts elicit unsafe content in 46.0% of cases, while self-harm prompts yield a lower rate (34.5%), predominantly through graphic violence. All evaluated models demonstrated substantial capabilities for generating violent and stereotypical content, while community fine-tuned models showed particular vulnerability to sexually explicit prompts. Quality assessment shows that models largely maintain generation capabilities for harmful versus benign content, producing synthetic imagery of sufficient fidelity to pose risks for disinformation and abuse. Human evaluation further confirms that unsafe prompting does not severely impact image plausibility and photorealism, with more capable models such as FLUX.1-dev producing clearly realistic harmful images in 30.9% of cases. Analysis of automated moderation systems reveals critical limitations, allowing substantial harmful content to evade detection. Our evaluation of synthetic image detection algorithms reveals that models trained solely on benign datasets perform worse on explicit content, while those incorporating diverse training data improve detection, highlighting semantic distribution gaps in current approaches. These findings highlight gaps between current safety measures and detection capabilities, demonstrating the need for more robust approaches to prevent misuse of text-to-image generation systems at scale.

paragraphs.en: The rapid advancement of text-to-image (T2I) generative models has transformed visual content creation, enabling users to produce realistic images from text prompts. Models such as DALL-E ( Ramesh et al., 2021 ) , and Stable Diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2022a ) have achieved remarkable ability to generate high-quality, photorealistic images that are increasingly difficult to distinguish from authentic photographs ( Bougueffa et al., 2024 ) . However, these capabilities come with risks of misuse. Large-scale training datasets have been found to include thousands of images of suspected child sexual abuse, pornographic content, hate symbols, and other problematic material ( Birhane et al., 2021 ; Bird et al., 2023 ) . These risks extend to information integrity through the T2I models’ capacity to create convincing manipulations and fabricated content that can be weaponised in the context of disinformation campaigns, e.g. create photorealistic images of events that never occurred or manipulate visual evidence to support false narratives ( Dufour et al., 2024 ) . This capability is particularly concerning in news and journalism, since it threatens to undermine public trust in legitimate media and complicate efforts to distinguish authentic reporting from manufactured content ( Radcliffe, 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: Proposed safety measures include including content filters, prompt screening, and model fine-tuning to prevent harmful outputs. These approaches typically involve filtering inappropriate inputs and outputs, implementing external safety classifiers ( LAION-AI, 2024 ; CompVis, 2022 ) , removing unsafe content from training data before it reaches the model ( Rombach et al., 2022a ; Schramowski et al., 2023 ) or fine-tuning the model by penalizing unsafe content generation ( Han et al., 2024 ) . However, circumventing such safety measures can often be trivial by downloading the models locally and disabling the external safety mechanisms, using models without internal safety mechanisms, using models that have been fine-tuned on datasets with explicit content ( Wagner and Cetinic, 2025 ) or via jailbreaking attacks ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) . Our work demonstrates that none of these techniques are necessary: a malicious actor requires only an open-weight instruction-tuned model and a consumer GPU to generate harmful content at scale.
paragraphs.zh: 提议的安全措施包括内容过滤器、提示词筛查和模型微调，以防止生成有害输出。 这些方法通常涉及过滤不当的输入和输出，部署外部安全分类器（LAION-AI, 2024；CompVis, 2022），在内容到达模型之前从训练数据中移除不安全的内容（Rombach et al., 2022a；Schramowski et al., 2023），或通过惩罚生成不安全内容来对模型进行微调（Han et al., 2024）。 然而，通过本地下载模型并禁用外部安全机制、使用没有内部安全机制的模型、使用在包含露骨内容的数据集上微调过的模型（Wagner and Cetinic, 2025），或借助越狱攻击（Jiang et al., 2025），往往可以轻松绕过这些安全措施。 我们的研究证明，这些技术中没有任何一项是必要的：恶意行为者只需一个开放权重的指令微调模型和一块消费级GPU，就能大规模生成有害内容。

paragraphs.en: Despite growing awareness of these risks and documented evidence of harmful content generation capabilities ( Dufour et al., 2024 ) , systematic evaluations of current T2I models’ responses to potentially harmful prompts are scarce. To address this gap, in this paper we systematically evaluate modern T2I models’ harmful content generation. We begin with the VisualNews dataset ( Liu et al., 2021 ) , which contains captions of real-world news events and photographs. We employ an automated pipeline using a large language model (LLM) to systematically convert these captions into harmful prompts across five critical categories: sexually explicit content, violent imagery (gore), harmful stereotypes, self-harm, and hate speech. The choice of VisualNews allows us to work with authentic descriptions of real-world events and scenarios. By transforming these captions into harmful variants, we can assess how easily generative models can be manipulated to produce harmful content from starting points that users might naturally encounter. This approach better reflects realistic threat scenarios where malicious actors might exploit legitimate news content to generate misleading or harmful imagery.

paragraphs.en: We validate the effectiveness of our prompt conversion process using established text moderation tools to confirm that the transformed prompts are successfully classified as harmful across our target categories. Subsequently, we generate images using a diverse range of models, including models that have been specifically fine-tuned on explicit content. We conduct a human evaluation study on a sample of generated images, asking annotators to assess whether images contain harmful visual content as well as their perceived photorealism and plausibility. We also employ automated tools to assess the quality and prompt adherence of the generated content. Finally, we analyze all generated images using state-of-the-art image moderation tools to determine the extent to which harmful prompts successfully produce harmful visual outputs. Additionally, we evaluate synthetic image detection algorithms to assess their performance on explicit content, examining whether semantic content affects detectability. Using the human-annotated subset as ground truth, we evaluate the performance of these automated moderation systems and reveal critical limitations in them, quantifying the gap between current safety measures and actual harmful content detection capabilities for AI generated images. To our knowledge, no prior work jointly evaluates this full pipeline, covering scalable harmful prompt generation, commercial moderation tool failure, and semantic distribution shift in synthetic image detection, under a realistic and accessible threat scenario that requires no specialized expertise.

paragraphs.en: Our main contribution can be summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要贡献可概括如下：

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate that automated pipelines can enable harmful content generation at scale by systematically transforming neutral captions into unsafe prompts across multiple categories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，自动化流程可以通过系统性地将中性描述转化为多个类别中的不安全提示，从而实现有害内容的规模化生成。

paragraphs.en: We confirm through a human study that current image generation models can produce harmful visual content with all models showing substantial capabilities for generating violent and stereotypical content, while community-fine-tuned models show particular vulnerability to sexually explicit prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过一项人类研究证实，当前的图像生成模型能够生成有害的视觉内容，所有模型都展现出生成暴力和刻板印象内容的显著能力，而经过社区微调的模型则对性暗示提示表现出特别的脆弱性。

paragraphs.en: We show that, as measured by automatic quality metrics, models maintain comparable scores on harmful prompts relative to safe ones.
paragraphs.zh: 我们表明，根据自动质量指标衡量，模型在处理有害提示时的得分与处理安全提示时相比保持相当。

paragraphs.en: We reveal critical limitations in existing moderation systems, finding high precision but low recall, allowing substantial unsafe content to bypass safety measures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们揭示了现有内容审核系统的关键局限性：虽然其精确度很高，但召回率却很低，导致大量不安全内容能够绕过安全机制。

paragraphs.en: We show that moderation models cannot effectively flag images that potentially amplify biases and harmful stereotypes and promote hate speech.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，内容审核模型无法有效标记那些可能放大偏见和有害刻板印象、并助长仇恨言论的图片。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate that synthetic image detection models trained on benign datasets show reduced performance on explicit content, highlighting semantic distribution gaps in current detection approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，在良性数据集上训练的合成图像检测模型在检测明确内容时的性能有所下降，这凸显了当前检测方法中语义分布的差距。

paragraphs.en: T2I generation has undergone substantial evolution across multiple architectural approaches. Early methods were dominated by Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) ( Goodfellow et al., 2014 ) , with architectures like StyleGAN ( Karras et al., 2019 ) and BigGAN ( Brock et al., 2019 ) demonstrating high-quality image synthesis capabilities, though often limited to specific domains or requiring specially designed training stability techniques. The introduction of denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs) ( Ho et al., 2020 ) marked a seminal shift, providing a likelihood-based framework for stable training and increasingly competitive image quality. GLIDE ( Nichol et al., 2022 ) extended this direction by introducing classifier-free guidance, substantially improving text–image alignment in diffusion models. In parallel, DALL-E ( Ramesh et al., 2021 ) demonstrated the potential of autoregressive transformers for T2I generation. Its successor, DALL-E 2 ( Ramesh et al., 2022 ) , transitioned to a diffusion-based framework, combining a prior over CLIP embeddings with a diffusion decoder to produce high-quality images. Imagen ( Saharia et al., 2022 ) achieved state-of-the-art photorealism through cascaded diffusion models conditioned on large language model encoders. The Stable Diffusion family ( Rombach et al., 2022a ) made high-quality generation accessible by operating in latent space rather than pixel space, enabling efficient training and inference. Several recent surveys ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Cao et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) provide context for these advances, highlighting major architectural trends, theoretical developments, and the open challenges that remain in image generation.
paragraphs.zh: T2I 生成技术经过多种架构方法的演进，取得了显著的进步。 早期的方法主要由生成对抗网络（GANs）（Goodfellow 等人，2014）主导，其中 StyleGAN（Karras 等人，2019）和 BigGAN（Brock 等人，2019）等架构展现了高质量的图像合成能力，尽管通常局限于特定领域或需要专门设计的训练稳定性技术。 去噪扩散概率模型（DDPMs）（Ho 等人，2020）的引入标志着一个里程碑式的转变，为稳定训练和日益具有竞争力的图像质量提供了基于似然度的框架。 GLIDE（Nichol 等人，2022）通过引入无分类器引导扩展了这一方向，显著提升了扩散模型中的文本与图像对齐能力。 与此同时，DALL-E（Ramesh 等人，2021）展示了自回归变换器在 T2I 生成方面的潜力。 其后续版本 DALL-E 2（Ramesh 等人，2022）转向了基于扩散的框架，将 CLIP 嵌入的先验知识与扩散解码器相结合，以生成高质量的图像。 Imagen（Saharia 等人，2022）通过基于大型语言模型编码器的级联扩散模型，实现了当前最先进的照片级真实感。 Stable Diffusion 系列（Rombach 等人，2022a）通过在潜在空间而非像素空间进行运算，使高质量生成变得可行，从而实现了高效的训练和推理。 近期的多项综述（Zhang 等人，2024；Cao 等人，2024；Chen 等人，2025）为这些进展提供了背景，重点介绍了主要的架构趋势、理论发展以及图像生成领域尚未解决的挑战。

paragraphs.en: Large-scale training datasets used for T2I models were found to contain significant amounts of harmful content. The LAION-5B dataset ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ) , used to train models such as Stable Diffusion, has been shown to include hateful content, misogynistic stereotypes, demographic biases ( Birhane et al., 2021 ) , and instances of child sexual abuse ( Thiel, 2023 ) . Although cleaned versions were subsequently released ( LAION, 2024 ) , widely used models including Stable Diffusion 1.5 were trained on earlier versions, allowing these issues to persist ( Yeh et al., 2024 ) .

paragraphs.en: To address potential misuse by malicious actors and mitigate potential biases inherent in their training datasets, T2I models employ various safety mechanisms to prevent harmful content generation. Safety mechanisms broadly include inference-time filtering and training-time interventions. The former includes prompt screening and generated image filtering, while the latter includes training data curation ( Rombach et al., 2022b ) , safety-oriented fine-tuning ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ) , embedding space interventions such as SafeCLIP ( Poppi et al., 2024 ) , and preference alignment ( OpenAI, 2023 ) . More recently, Bai et al. (2026) propose a concept erasure approach that suppresses undesirable concepts such as nudity, violence, and hate while preserving non-target content and improving robustness to adversarial prompt variations. However, research has demonstrated that these safety mechanisms can often be easily bypassed ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Rando et al., 2022 ) . Moreover, many filters focus primarily on sexual content while inadequately addressing violence, gore, and other forms of harmful imagery, creating significant gaps in protection ( Rando et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 为应对恶意行为者可能存在的滥用行为，并减轻其训练数据集中固有的潜在偏见，T2I 模型采用了多种安全机制，以防止生成有害内容。 安全机制大致包括推理时的过滤和训练时的干预措施。 前者包括提示筛选和生成图像过滤，而后者则包括训练数据整理（Rombach 等人，2022b）、面向安全的微调（Schramowski 等人，2023）、嵌入空间干预（如 SafeCLIP，Poppi 等人，2024）以及偏好对齐（OpenAI，2023）。 近期，Bai 等人 （2026）提出了一种概念消除方法，该方法能够抑制裸体、暴力和仇恨等不期望的概念，同时保留非目标内容，并提升模型对对抗性提示变化的鲁棒性。 然而，研究已表明，这些安全机制往往可以被轻易绕过（Jiang 等人，2025；Rando 等人，2022）。 此外，许多过滤器主要关注性内容，而对暴力、血腥及其他形式的有害图像处理不足，从而在保护方面留下了显著漏洞（Rando 等人，2022）。

paragraphs.en: Despite their beneficial applications across domains, foundation models enable the generation of “high-quality, cheap, and personalized content for harmful purposes,” lowering barriers for malicious content creation ( Bommasani et al., 2022 ) . Despite the benefits of open-source generative AI models, their accessibility increases misuse risks by removing commercial safety barriers and enabling customization for harmful applications ( Eiras et al., 2024 ; Vykopal et al., 2024 ) . AI-generated content presents challenges including political misinformation, identity-based attacks, manipulation schemes, and fraud operations ( Xu et al., 2023a ) . Model capabilities reduce both the cost and technical expertise required for generating harmful content at scale. Evidence from real-world deployments demonstrates this progression from potential to practice, with documented increases in deepfake creation following tool releases and the emergence of commercial marketplaces for synthetic content generation ( Pu et al., 2021 ; Gamage et al., 2022 ; Loth et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2024 ; Chrysidis et al., 2026 ) . Closely related to our work, Qu et al. (2023) assess the proportion of unsafe images generated by T2I models across five harm categories and evaluate hateful meme generation using image editing techniques such as DreamBooth, while He et al. (2024) employ LLM-assisted fuzzing to construct diverse malicious prompts across fine-grained risk categories while avoiding sensitive terms to bypass T2I content auditing. In contrast, our work adopts a simpler, corpus-driven threat model, demonstrating that any neutral text corpus can be systematically transformed into harmful prompts using a single open-weight LLM, without probing the target model or explicitly optimizing prompts to evade its safety mechanisms.

paragraphs.en: Building on these broader concerns, T2I models demonstrate significant inherent capabilities to generate harmful visual content across multiple categories. Empirical studies have documented models’ abilities to produce violent imagery, sexually explicit material, gore, and other disturbing visual content when prompted with both explicit and seemingly innocuous prompts ( Schramowski et al., 2023 ; Qu et al., 2023 ) . Research has also identified “harm amplification” phenomena, where models generate harmful representations that were not explicitly present in seemingly safe input prompts, posing risks to users who may be unintentionally exposed to disturbing content ( Hao et al., 2024 ) . In addition to generating overtly harmful content, T2I models can amplify societal biases and misrepresent groups of people, producing stereotypical or prejudiced depictions based on race, gender, or other attributes ( Ungless et al., 2023 ; Bianchi et al., 2023a ) . Furthermore, open-source diffusion models can be easily fine-tuned with harmful datasets to bypass existing safety measures, enabling the generation of NSFW content with minimal effort ( Pan et al., 2024 ) . A recent study analyzing images and models shared on the social platform CivitAI, a popular platform for distributing generative models, found that a significant portion of content and models is dedicated to creating NSFW and abusive material ( Wei et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 基于这些更广泛的担忧，T2I模型展现出显著的内在能力，能够生成多个类别中的有害视觉内容。 实证研究已记录，当使用明确或看似无害的提示时，模型能够生成暴力图像、性暗示材料、血腥画面及其他令人不安的视觉内容（Schramowski等，2023；Qu等，2023）。 研究还发现了“危害放大”现象：模型会生成在看似安全的输入提示中并未明确出现的有害表现，从而对可能无意中接触到令人不安内容的用户构成风险（Hao等，2024）。 除了生成明显有害的内容外，T2I模型还可能放大社会偏见并错误描绘特定群体，基于种族、性别或其他属性生成刻板或带有偏见的形象（Ungless等，2023；Bianchi等，2023a）。 此外，开源扩散模型可通过有害数据集轻松进行微调以绕过现有安全措施，从而以极小的努力生成NSFW内容（Pan等，2024）。 最近一项针对社交平台CivitAI上共享的图像和模型的分析研究发现，该平台上用于分发生成式模型的内容和模型中，有相当一部分专门用于创作NSFW和滥用性材料（Wei等，2024）。

paragraphs.en: Content moderation research has focused on detecting harmful content across various domains, with particular challenges emerging around synthetic and AI-generated material. Early systems like Perspective API ( Google, 2022 ) established foundational approaches for toxic language detection in online environments. Recent advances have adapted large language models specifically for content moderation, with specialized models fine-tuned to detect harmful content in both prompts and AI outputs ( Inan et al., 2023 ; Ghosh et al., 2024 ; Tan et al., 2025 ; Han et al., 2024 ) and have shown improved performance against attempts to generate prohibited content. However, these systems still face severe challenges. Several studies have highlighted difficulties for content moderation systems that must balance automated efficiency with accuracy constraints while facing declining user trust as inadequate detection methods undermine confidence in the platforms’ ability to reliably identify AI-generated content ( Xu et al., 2023a ; Lee and Liu, 2025 ; Chen and Zou, 2023 ; Feng et al., 2023 ; Lloyd et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 内容审核研究一直专注于检测不同领域中的有害内容，而合成和人工智能生成的材料则带来了特殊的挑战。 早期系统（如 Perspective API（Google，2022））为在线环境中有毒语言的检测建立了基础方法。 近期的进展已将大型语言模型专门用于内容审核，其中一些专用模型经过微调，能够检测提示和人工智能输出中的有害内容（Inan 等，2023；Ghosh 等，2024；Tan 等，2025；Han 等，2024），并表现出更出色的性能，以应对生成禁止内容的尝试。 然而，这些系统仍然面临严峻的挑战。 多项研究指出，内容审核系统在平衡自动化效率与准确性限制的同时，还面临着用户信任度下降的问题，因为不充分的检测方法削弱了用户对平台可靠识别人工智能生成内容能力的信心（Xu 等，2023a；Lee 和 Liu，2025；Chen 和 Zou，2023；Feng 等，2023；Lloyd 等，2025）。

paragraphs.en: Complementing content moderation efforts, synthetic image detection has emerged as an approach to identify AI-generated images through various methodologies. Detection methods range from supervised approaches that train classifiers on labeled datasets ( Chai et al., 2020 ) to CLIP-based methods that leverage pre-trained vision-language models ( Ojha et al., 2024 ; Koutlis and Papadopoulos, 2024 ) , and reconstruction techniques that measure discrepancies between original and reconstructed images ( Karageorgiou et al., 2025 ) . However, most detection algorithms follow a data-driven approach, typically training on datasets generated using COCO captions ( Corvi et al., 2022 ) . Current benchmarks primarily focus on distinguishing between different generative architectures rather than evaluating performance across diverse content types. This creates limitations when detection systems encounter content that differs from their training distributions. Recent work has demonstrated that incorporating synthetic images collected “in the wild” from social media platforms can significantly improve detection performance ( Konstantinidou et al., 2025 ) , suggesting that the semantic content of synthetic images affects detectability.
paragraphs.zh: 作为内容审核工作的补充，合成图像检测已成为一种通过多种方法识别人工智能生成图像的手段。 检测方法涵盖从在带标签数据集上训练分类器的监督方法（Chai et al., 2020），到利用预训练视觉-语言模型的基于CLIP的方法（Ojha et al., 2024；Koutlis and Papadopoulos, 2024），以及衡量原始图像与重建图像之间差异的重建技术（Karageorgiou et al., 2025）。 然而，大多数检测算法都遵循数据驱动的方法，通常在使用COCO标题生成的数据集上进行训练（Corvi et al., 2022）。 当前的基准测试主要关注区分不同的生成架构，而非评估其在多样化内容类型上的性能表现。 这导致当检测系统遇到与其训练分布不同的内容时，会出现局限性。 近期的研究表明，从社交媒体平台“真实场景”中收集合成图像并加以利用，可以显著提升检测性能（Konstantinidou et al., 2025），这说明合成图像的语义内容会影响其可检测性。

paragraphs.en: We devise a systematic pipeline to evaluate the harmful content generation capabilities of T2I models at scale. Our approach leverages LLMs and T2I models to simulate realistic attack scenarios where malicious actors aim to use open models to generate harmful imagery. The pipeline serves two primary purposes: (1) mimicking human behavior in how potentially unsafe content could be crafted effortlessly using public datasets and open LLMs, and (2) providing an automated framework to assess harmful content generation capabilities at scale, enabling comprehensive evaluation across multiple models and content categories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了一套系统化的流程，用于大规模评估 T2I 模型生成有害内容的能力。 我们的方法利用 LLM 和 T2I 模型来模拟真实的攻击场景，在这些场景中，恶意行为者试图利用开放模型生成有害图像。 该流程主要有两个目的：（1）模仿人类行为，展示如何利用公开数据集和开放 LLM 轻松创建潜在不安全的内容；（2）提供一个自动化框架，用于大规模评估有害内容生成能力，从而实现对多种模型和内容类别的全面评估。

sents.zh: 我们设计了一套系统化的流程，用于大规模评估 T2I 模型生成有害内容的能力。

paragraphs.en: Threat Model. We consider a realistic threat scenario in which a malicious actor has access to a consumer GPU and seeks to generate harmful visual content at scale. This actor does not require specialized expertise, jailbreaking techniques, or adversarial prompt engineering. It suffices to use an open-weight instruction-tuned model that complies with harmful instructions and iteratively refines a system prompt until the outputs meet their requirements. On the defender side, we consider the practical safeguards currently deployed by platforms: moderation APIs that flag harmful content and synthetic image detection algorithms that identify AI-generated imagery. Our evaluation pipeline is designed to systematically stress-test both the attacker’s generation capability and the defender’s detection robustness within this scenario.
paragraphs.zh: 威胁模型。 我们考虑一个现实的威胁场景：恶意行为者能够使用消费级 GPU，并试图大规模生成有害的视觉内容。 该行为者无需具备专业 expertise、越狱技术或对抗性提示工程能力。 只需使用一个开放权重的指令微调模型，使其能够遵循有害指令，并通过迭代优化系统提示，直至输出满足其要求即可。 在防御方，我们考虑平台当前部署的实际防护手段：用于标记有害内容的审核 API，以及用于识别 AI 生成图像的合成图像检测算法。 我们的评估流程旨在在此场景下，系统地测试攻击方的生成能力与防御方的检测鲁棒性。

sents.en: Our evaluation pipeline is designed to systematically stress-test both the attacker’s generation capability and the defender’s detection robustness within this scenario.
sents.zh: 我们的评估流程旨在在此场景下，系统地测试攻击方的生成能力与防御方的检测鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: We begin with a collection of captions that serve as a starting point rather than generating prompts from scratch for two reasons. First, using diverse starting points as “seeds” increases the variability and realism of the resulting unsafe prompts, as they reflect different real-world entities and events. Second, the original safe prompts serve as a natural reference set for comparative analysis, allowing us to assess whether models exhibit equal capabilities in generating high-quality harmful versus benign content. To assess harmful content generation risks, we systematically transform original captions into unsafe prompts targeting categories of content that pose significant safety concerns. The transformation process uses category-specific prompting methodologies that instruct the LLM to create visually descriptive scenes incorporating harmful elements. We validate that our transformed prompts contained harmful content, as intended, using multiple specialized text classification models.

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation addresses the central research question: How successfully can current T2I models generate harmful content when prompted appropriately? We employ a multi-level assessment approach that quantifies both attack success rates and the effectiveness of current detection mechanisms.

paragraphs.en: To assess whether images generated from unsafe prompts actually contain harmful content, we employ pretrained content moderation systems. However, given documented limitations in automated detection systems, we conducted a human evaluation study using stratified sampling across caption types and generation models to establish reliable ground truth labels. Annotators were informed that all images were AI-generated. For each image, annotators rated five harm dimensions – sexually explicit content, stereotypes, violence/gore, self-harm, and hate speech – using a four-point scale: no , mild , moderate , and extreme . Ratings are guided by two dimensions considered jointly: the graphicness of the depiction (how explicit, severe, or detailed the harmful content is) and the apparent intent to depict or promote that content. The latter is particularly relevant for categories such as self-harm, stereotypes, and hate speech, where the same visual elements may carry very different meaning depending on context. In addition to the harm dimensions, annotators rated each image on a realism scale ( N/A , no , potentially , likely , yes ), reflecting how convincingly the image could be mistaken for a real photograph, combining rendering quality with scene plausibility. Full annotation guidelines, including per-category level descriptions, are provided in the Appendix. This enabled us to quantify the success rate of harmful content generation and the gap between current automated safety measures and actual harmful content detection capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估由不安全提示生成的图像是否确实包含有害内容，我们采用了预训练的内容审核系统。 然而，鉴于自动化检测系统已知的局限性，我们对不同标题类型和生成模型进行了分层抽样，并开展了人工评估研究，以建立可靠的基准标签。 标注人员被告知所有图像均为人工智能生成。 对于每张图像，标注人员使用四分制量表对五个有害维度进行评分：性暗示内容、刻板印象、暴力/血腥内容、自残以及仇恨言论，选项分别为：无、轻微、中等和极端。 评分基于两个共同考量的维度：描绘的直观程度（即有害内容的明确性、严重性或细节程度），以及描绘或推广该内容的明显意图。 后一个维度对于自残、刻板印象和仇恨言论等类别尤为重要，因为相同的视觉元素在不同语境下可能具有截然不同的含义。 除了有害维度外，标注人员还根据真实感量表（不适用、无、可能、很可能、是）对每张图像进行评分，该量表反映了图像在渲染质量和场景合理性结合下，被误认为真实照片的可能性。 完整的标注指南，包括各类别的等级描述，均附于附录中。 这使得我们能够量化有害内容生成的成功率，以及当前自动化安全措施与实际有害内容检测能力之间的差距。

paragraphs.en: Beyond detecting harmful content, we assess the quality and prompt adherence of generated images using image quality assessment metrics. This quality assessment addresses whether models retain their generative capabilities when processing harmful prompts or output quality is reduced. Since T2I models achieve state-of-the-art performance on safe content generation benchmarks, we use images generated from original safe prompts as our reference standard. We employ two human preference metrics: ImageReward ( Xu et al., 2023b ) , a BLIP-based ( Li et al., 2022 ) model that fuses image and text features via cross-attention and an MLP head to produce a scalar score reflecting joint perceptual quality and prompt adherence; and Human Preference Score v2.1 (HPS) ( Wu et al., 2023 ) , a CLIP ViT-H/14 ( Radford et al., 2021 ) model fine-tuned on large-scale pairwise human preference annotations, which scores an image-prompt pair by their learned embedding similarity. Both metrics output a single scalar quantifying how well a generated image matches its prompt and overall image quality according to human preference. Additionally, we evaluate synthetic image detection (SID) algorithms to assess their performance on explicit content. We test both standard detection models trained on benign datasets and “in-the-wild” variants trained on datasets containing explicit content. This analysis examines whether the semantic content of synthetic images affects detectability, addressing potential data drift issues when detection systems encounter content distributions different from their training data.
paragraphs.zh: 除了检测有害内容外，我们还利用图像质量评估指标来评估生成图像的质量及其对提示的遵循程度。 这项质量评估旨在判断模型在处理有害提示时是否仍保留其生成能力，或者输出质量是否会下降。 由于 T2I 模型在安全内容生成基准测试中已达到当前最优性能，因此我们将使用原始安全提示生成的图像作为参考标准。 我们采用了两种人类偏好评估指标：ImageReward（Xu et al., 2023b），这是一种基于 BLIP（Li et al., 2022）的模型，通过交叉注意力和 MLP 头部融合图像与文本特征，生成一个标量分数，反映联合感知质量与提示遵循程度；以及 Human Preference Score v2.1（HPS）（Wu et al., 2023），这是一种基于 CLIP ViT-H/14（Radford et al., 2021）的模型，在大规模成对的人类偏好标注数据上进行了微调，通过已学习的嵌入相似度为图像-提示对打分。 这两种指标都能输出一个单一标量值，用于量化生成图像在多大程度上符合其提示以及根据人类偏好的整体图像质量。 此外，我们还评估了合成图像检测（SID）算法，以检验它们在检测露骨内容方面的性能。 我们测试了两种模型：在良性数据集上训练的标准检测模型，以及在包含露骨内容的数据集上训练的“野生”变体模型。 这项分析旨在探究合成图像的语义内容是否会影响其可检测性，从而应对检测系统在遇到与训练数据分布不同的内容时可能出现的潜在数据漂移问题。

paragraphs.en: We use the Visual News dataset ( Liu et al., 2021 ) for safe prompts and focus on five categories of harmful content: sexually explicit material, violent imagery, harmful stereotypes, hate speech and self-harm. We employ Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407 ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) for prompt transformation, because Mistral models have demonstrated capabilities in generating misinformation ( Vykopal et al., 2024 ) , and through empirical testing, it proved effective at producing sufficiently disturbing content for our evaluation purposes.

paragraphs.en: To justify our LLM selection for prompt transformation, we conduct a comparative test of five instruction-tuned LLMs of similar scale: Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407 ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) , Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Qwen et al., 2025 ) , LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , Gemma-2-9B-IT ( Team et al., 2024 ) , and Phi-4 ( Abdin et al., 2024 ) . We evaluate the generated prompts using three complementary classifiers: Detoxify ( Hanu and Unitary team, 2020 ) , which scores text across toxicity, obscenity, and insult; bart-large-mnli 7 7 7 https://huggingface.co/facebook/bart-large-mnli ( Lewis et al., 2019 ; Williams et al., 2018 ) , applied as a zero-shot classifier with candidate labels directly corresponding to our content categories (toxic, violent, sexually explicit, gore, hate speech, self harm, and NSFW); and bert-hateXplain ( Mathew et al., 2022 ) , trained specifically for hate speech and toxicity detection. Profanity is measured using a predefined word list 8 8 8 https://github.com/rrgeorge-pdcontributions/NSFW-Words-List/ as the percentage of prompts containing at least one profane term.
paragraphs.zh: 为证明我们选择 LLM 进行提示转换的合理性，我们对五个规模相近的指令微调 LLM 进行了对比测试：Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407（Jiang 等人，2023）、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct（Qwen 等人，2025）、LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct（Grattafiori 等人，2024）、Gemma-2-9B-IT（Team 等人，2024）以及 Phi-4（Abdin 等人，2024）。 我们使用三种互补的分类器来评估生成的提示：Detoxify（Hanu 和 Unitary 团队，2020），该分类器对文本的毒性、粗俗性和侮辱性进行评分；bart-large-mnli 7 7 7 https://huggingface.co/facebook/bart-large-mnli（Lewis 等人，2019；Williams 等人，2018），作为零样本分类器使用，其候选标签直接对应于我们的内容类别（毒性、暴力、性暗示、血腥、仇恨言论、自我伤害和 NSFW）；以及 bert-hateXplain（Mathew 等人，2022），该分类器专门用于检测仇恨言论和毒性内容。 粗俗用语的衡量基于一个预定义词汇表 8 8 8 https://github.com/rrgeorge-pdcontributions/NSFW-Words-List/，通过计算至少包含一个粗俗术语的提示所占百分比来量化。

paragraphs.en: This section presents the results on the generated image evaluations. To assess whether generation quality degrades for harmful content categories, we apply a one-sided Welch’s t t -test for each model and category i i with H 0 : μ i = μ cap H_{0}:\mu_{i}=\mu_{\text{cap}} against H 1 : μ i < μ cap H_{1}:\mu_{i}<\mu_{\text{cap}} , where μ cap \mu_{\text{cap}} denotes the mean score of the safe caption group for that model. Failure to reject H 0 H_{0} indicates no statistically significant degradation in generation quality for that category. Our evaluation reveals significant variations in how image generation models handle harmful content. To provide context for these scores, we include evaluation results from the original Visual News dataset images corresponding to the safe captions. Since these real images are of lower resolution and fidelity compared to generated images, and this is typically penalized by quality metrics, we applied Super-Resolution GAN (SRGAN) ( Ledig et al., 2017 ) upscaling to improve their resolution before evaluation. Still, real images achieved relatively modest scores of 0.11 for ImageReward and 24.00 for HPS v2.1, establishing a baseline for comparison with generated content.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 5 , ImageReward scores for gore increase across all models, indicating that the metric does not penalize this content type. Harmful stereotypes, hate speech, and self-harm show mixed results, with some models scoring comparably to or above their caption baseline and others showing significant degradation. paragraphs.en: In this section we present the results from the human annotation study to determine a ground truth for the effectiveness of the models to generate harmful content from harmful prompts. Annotators independently rated each image across all five harm dimensions and realism. Inter-annotator agreement was measured using Fleiss’ Kappa ( Fleiss, 1971 ) . Almost perfect agreement is observed for Sexually Explicit (0.8454), Violence/Gore (0.8513), and Self-Harm (0.8014). For Hate Speech (0.6059) and Stereotypes (0.6241) there is lower but still substantial agreement, reflecting that these categories inherently rely on cultural context, coded symbols, and nuanced interpretation, making absolute consensus more challenging to achieve. Realism shows moderate agreement (0.4557) and this can be attributed to the inherent subjectivity in judging image naturalness and plausibility. Ground-truth labels were obtained from the mean annotation. For binary analyses, we adopted a conservative mapping in which mild , moderate , and extreme were considered unsafe ; results under the alternative mapping, which groups mild with safe , are reported in the appendix.

paragraphs.en: These findings provide insights into the susceptibility of image generation models to producing different types of harmful content when given malicious prompts. Self-harm prompts also trigger substantial violent imagery (71.9%), as models tend to depict self-harm through graphic violence rather than more subtle representations. Models show moderate susceptibility to generating hate speech (46.0%), sexual content (47.6%), stereotype content (43.6% success rate), and self-harm content (34.5%) when given corresponding harmful prompts. The automated nature of this generation process highlights the significant risk of producing harmful images at scale, demonstrating the critical need for robust safety measures in image generation systems to prevent misuse through adversarial prompting.

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 shows realism score distributions for safe vs. harmful images across all five models. Harmful prompting generally shifts the distributions toward lower realism, although the magnitude of this effect varies substantially across models. FLUX.1-dev shows the clearest drop, with the proportion of images rated as clearly realistic decreasing from 63.3% for safe images to 30.9% for harmful images. Despite this reduction, FLUX.1-dev retains the highest proportion of clearly realistic harmful images among the evaluated models. Juggernaut-XL shows a similar, though smaller, shift, with clearly realistic images decreasing from 20.8% to 11.1%. For SD3.5, only 1.7% of harmful images are rated as clearly realistic, indicating that realism is largely lost for its harmful outputs. AbsoluteReality shows little change between safe and harmful prompting, but this reflects its generally low realism in both settings: 76.7% and 75.4% of its safe and harmful images, respectively, are rated as non-realistic. Thus, the extent to which realism is retained under harmful prompting is strongly model dependent rather than consistent across all models. A Mann–Whitney U test on ordinal realism scores confirms that only FLUX.1-dev reaches statistical significance ( p = 1.35 × 10 − 5 p=1.35\times 10^{-5} ); the remaining models show visible but non-significant distributional shifts. Nevertheless, the finding that 30.9% of FLUX.1-dev’s harmful images are rated as clearly realistic demonstrates that some models can still produce photorealistic harmful imagery under the automated, at-scale threat model considered here.

paragraphs.en: We further compare these results against the automatic quality metrics, noting that the two are not directly comparable: human realism annotation focused on photographic believability and plausibility and did not account for prompt adherence, whereas HPS v2.1 and ImageReward jointly reward both. This is most evident for FLUX.1-dev, where human realism degrades significantly under harmful prompting while both metrics assign it higher quality scores than for safe images. The results in Table 5 should therefore be interpreted as measuring prompt adherence and aesthetic quality rather than photographic realism.

paragraphs.en: The most effective way to mitigate these risks at scale is through automated content moderation. However, the results in Table 8 and Figure 3 show that current moderation systems exhibit significant limitations across categories. We report 95% confidence intervals for all metrics computed via non-parametric bootstrapping with 1,000 resamples using the percentile method. ShieldGemma and OpenAI lack specific Hate Speech and Stereotype categories; we therefore use the maximum score across all available output classes to determine whether harmful content is flagged in any capacity.
paragraphs.zh: 大规模缓解这些风险最有效的方法是通过自动内容审核。 然而，表 8 和图 3 的结果表明，当前的审核系统在各个类别中都存在显著局限性。 我们使用百分位法，通过非参数自助法进行 1,000 次重采样，为所有计算出的指标报告了 95% 的置信区间。 ShieldGemma 和 OpenAI 缺少针对仇恨言论和刻板印象的具体类别；因此，我们使用所有可用输出类别中的最高分数来判断是否以任何形式标记了有害内容。

paragraphs.en: For sexually explicit content, OpenAI achieves very high precision (98.2%, CI: 94.2–100.0%) but low recall (30.4%, CI: 24.0–37.6%), confirming an accuracy bias that misses many problematic cases. Rekognition offers a better trade-off (64.7% precision, 70.7% recall, AUC-ROC 0.83), while ShieldGemma performs near chance level (AUC-ROC 0.50, CI: 0.46–0.54). For violence, OpenAI is the strongest system (AUC-ROC 0.94, AUC-PR 0.91) with high precision (93.4%) and recall (68.6%), followed closely by Rekognition (AUC-ROC 0.81, recall 63.4%). ShieldGemma trails both with recall of only 37.2% and AUC-ROC 0.79. Stereotype detection is the most challenging category: all three systems perform near or below random chance (AUC-ROC 0.46–0.49), with Rekognition and OpenAI flagging virtually no images at the 0.5 threshold. The tight confidence intervals here (e.g., Rekognition AUC-ROC CI: 0.49–0.50) confirm that this near-random performance is not an artifact of threshold choice but a fundamental failure to detect stereotype content. Self-harm reveals a sharp contrast in operating regimes: OpenAI achieves 93.3% precision (CI: 77.8–100.0%) but only 14.9% recall, while Rekognition and ShieldGemma recover more cases (64.9% and 58.5% recall respectively) at the cost of very low precision (~9–18%). OpenAI’s AUC-ROC of 0.95 confirms strong ranking ability despite its conservative threshold behavior. Hate speech is the second hardest category: OpenAI flags almost nothing (recall 4.3%, AUC-ROC 0.49), and Rekognition achieves perfect precision (100.0%) but detects only 6.8% of cases, indicating it identifies hate speech with certainty in rare instances. ShieldGemma performs best here with AUC-ROC 0.64 (CI: 0.60–0.68) and recall 56.0%, though at modest precision (22.4%). The ROC curves in Figure 3 confirm that these limitations persist across all operating points, reflecting fundamental gaps in the ability of current moderation systems to detect AI-generated harmful content. The synthetic nature of these images likely contributes to these challenges, as moderation systems are likely trained primarily on real-world imagery and thus suffer from the underlying distribution shift in synthetic images.
paragraphs.zh: 对于性暗示内容，OpenAI 实现了极高的精确度（98.2%，置信区间：94.2–100.0%），但召回率较低（30.4%，置信区间：24.0–37.6%），这证实了其存在准确性偏差，导致许多问题案例被遗漏。 Rekognition 提供了更优的权衡结果（精确度 64.7%，召回率 70.7%，AUC-ROC 0.83），而 ShieldGemma 的表现接近随机水平（AUC-ROC 0.50，置信区间：0.46–0.54）。 在暴力内容方面，OpenAI 是最强的系统（AUC-ROC 0.94，AUC-PR 0.91），具有高精度（93.4%）和高召回率（68.6%），Rekognition 紧随其后（AUC-ROC 0.81，召回率 63.4%）。 ShieldGemma 在这两项指标上均落后于前两者，其召回率仅为 37.2%，AUC-ROC 为 0.79。 刻板印象检测是最具挑战性的类别：所有三个系统的表现都接近或低于随机水平（AUC-ROC 0.46–0.49），其中 Rekognition 和 OpenAI 在 0.5 的阈值下几乎未标记出任何图像。 此处狭窄的置信区间（例如，Rekognition 的 AUC-ROC 置信区间：0.49–0.50）证实了这种接近随机水平的表现并非由阈值选择造成的偶然现象，而是无法检测刻板印象内容的根本性失败。 自我伤害内容揭示了不同运行机制之间的鲜明对比：OpenAI 实现了 93.3% 的精确度（置信区间：77.8–100.0%），但召回率仅为 14.9%；而 Rekognition 和 ShieldGemma 能够识别出更多案例（召回率分别为 64.9% 和 58.5%），但代价是精确度极低（约 9–18%）。 OpenAI 的 AUC-ROC 值为 0.95，证实了尽管其阈值设置较为保守，但仍具备强大的排序能力。 仇恨言论是第二难处理的类别：OpenAI 几乎未标记出任何内容（召回率 4.3%，AUC-ROC 0.49），而 Rekognition 实现了完美的精确度（100.0%），但仅检测到了 6.8% 的案例，表明它仅在极少数情况下能确定地识别出仇恨言论。 ShieldGemma 在此类别中表现最佳，AUC-ROC 为 0.64（置信区间：0.60–0.68），召回率为 56.0%，尽管精确度仅为中等水平（22.4%）。 图 3 中的 ROC 曲线证实了这些局限性在所有运行点上都持续存在，反映了当前内容审核系统在检测 AI 生成的有害内容方面存在根本性的能力差距。 这些图像的合成性质很可能加剧了上述挑战，因为内容审核系统可能主要基于真实世界的图像进行训练，因此会受到合成图像中潜在分布偏移的影响。

sents.en: The ROC curves in Figure 3 confirm that these limitations persist across all operating points, reflecting fundamental gaps in the ability of current moderation systems to detect AI-generated harmful content.

sents.en: The synthetic nature of these images likely contributes to these challenges, as moderation systems are likely trained primarily on real-world imagery and thus suffer from the underlying distribution shift in synthetic images.

paragraphs.en: Given the varying and generally low performance observed in the human-annotated subset, and assuming similar behavior across the full dataset, there are limited conclusions we can draw from automated classifications. The percentage of images flagged by these systems above the 0.5 threshold therefore serves as a conservative estimate of the true harmful content rate, as shown in Table 9 .

paragraphs.en: For sexually explicit content, AbsoluteReality exhibits the highest flagging rate for NSFW prompts (45.8%), followed by Juggernaut-XL (32.6%), while the remaining models show substantially lower rates (10.4–10.6%), confirming that community fine-tuned models are more susceptible to generating explicit content. For violence, both OpenAI and Rekognition agree on the ranking across models for gore prompts: Juggernaut-XL and SD3.5 exhibit the highest rates, while SDXL and FLUX.1-dev also show elevated rates, and AbsoluteReality remains the least susceptible. Self-harm prompts trigger substantial violent imagery across all models, with SD3.5 (OpenAI: 73.2%, Rekognition: 65.6%) and Juggernaut-XL (OpenAI: 64.9%, Rekognition: 63.4%) flagged most frequently, confirming that self-harm prompts reliably elicit graphic violent content. For hate speech, Rekognition flags meaningful content only for hate speech prompts, with FLUX.1-dev showing the highest rate (18.7%) and SD3.5 second (10.8%). These findings are consistent with the human annotation results in Table 7 and, given the high precision of the moderation models on the annotated subset, are expected to generalize to the full dataset.

paragraphs.en: We assess the synthetic image detectors described in Section 3 , including both the base models and their ITW variants (SPAI, RINE, and NPR), on content generated by T2I models. For evaluation, we use our human-annotated dataset where severity labels are consolidated by selecting the most severe rating when an image receives multiple severity classifications from the same annotator (e.g., an image rated as “extreme” for violence and “moderate” for sexual content would be classified as “extreme” overall). Table 10 presents the mean detection probabilities as percentages for each severity level. The results reveal a clear trend: models trained solely on COCO-based datasets exhibit reduced average detection scores for explicit content, while models that incorporate ITW training data demonstrate increased detection performance. For example, SPAI drops from 87.6% on safe content to 79.9% on extreme content, while SPAI-ITW increases from 81.4% to 97.3%. Similarly, NPR-ITW shows substantial improvements over NPR, rising from 60.0% to 73.1% detection rates as content severity increases. This represents an important limitation in current synthetic image detection approaches. Although ideally these systems should detect synthetic images regardless of semantic content, prior work has shown that detectors may struggle to generalize across different semantic concepts ( Dogoulis et al., 2023 ) . Our results further suggest that the training data distribution significantly influences detection capabilities and that explicit content absent from the original training sets may constitute a form of data drift. This highlights the importance of including explicit content in synthetic image detection benchmarks, especially given the potential harm associated with undetected synthetic content of this nature.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 T2I 模型生成的内容上，对第 3 节中描述的合成图像检测器进行了评估，包括基础模型及其 ITW 变体（SPAI、RINE 和 NPR）。 在评估中，我们使用了由人类标注的数据集。当一张图像从同一标注者处获得多个严重程度分类时，我们会选择其中最严重的评级作为最终标签（例如，一张图像在暴力方面被评为“极端”，在性内容方面被评为“中等”，则会被整体归类为“极端”）。 表 10 展示了每个严重程度级别的平均检测概率（以百分比表示）。 结果揭示了一个清晰的趋势：仅基于 COCO 数据集训练的模型在检测露骨内容时的平均得分较低，而融合了 ITW 训练数据的模型则表现出更高的检测性能。 例如，SPAI 在安全内容上的检测率为 87.6%，而在极端内容上降至 79.9%；相比之下，SPAI-ITW 的检测率则从 81.4% 提升至 97.3%。 同样地，NPR-ITW 相比 NPR 也有显著提升：随着内容严重程度的增加，其检测率从 60.0% 上升至 73.1%。 这反映了当前合成图像检测方法中的一个重要局限性。 理想情况下，这些系统应能无论语义内容如何都检测到合成图像，但先前的研究已表明，检测器可能难以在不同语义概念之间实现泛化（Dogoulis et al., 2023）。 我们的结果进一步表明，训练数据的分布对检测能力有显著影响，且原始训练集中缺失的露骨内容可能构成一种数据漂移。 这凸显了在合成图像检测基准中纳入露骨内容的重要性，尤其是考虑到此类未被检测到的合成内容可能带来的潜在危害。

paragraphs.en: The NSFW examples reveal particularly concerning patterns, including images bearing a resemblance to real people. While some are not entirely explicit, they remain highly suggestive, posing risks for non-consensual intimate imagery, identity theft, and reputation damage. The stereotype examples illustrate why this category is difficult to assess consistently. Annotators disagreed on the third image in the stereotype row, whose interpretation depends on whether its demographic and contextual cues are understood as invoking a harmful stereotype and whether the depiction is perceived as presenting a group in a derogatory manner. Such associations may depend on cultural background or prior exposure, providing a qualitative example of the lower agreement observed for stereotypes in Section 4.3 . Identifying such representations, therefore, requires nuanced cultural understanding that automated systems may struggle to capture. Despite these complexities, the complete absence of automated flagging for clearly problematic content is concerning. The gore examples required particularly heavy censoring due to their graphic nature. Generated violence was often excessive, although realistic cases were also produced, suggesting that violent content may receive less safety attention than NSFW content in terms of automated moderation, despite comparable risks. Hate-speech and self-harm examples reveal further moderation failures. Some hate-speech images contain overt hateful content and recognizable references to hate groups yet evade automated detection. Other examples are more ambiguous. One such image that caused disagreement between the annotators was the one that depicts a rally with UK flags. The national symbol alone does not establish hate speech, and annotators may differ in whether the broader scene implies an exclusionary or discriminatory context. Other examples contain more explicit textual cues, illustrating that hate-speech judgments may depend on combinations of scene context, symbols, and embedded text. These textual examples also highlight the importance of robust text understanding in visual moderation: generated text may contain misspellings, distorted characters, or challenging orientations, as seen in Figure 4 , which may prevent moderation systems from capturing part of the harmful meaning.
paragraphs.zh: 这些 NSFW 示例揭示了尤为令人担忧的模式，包括与真实人物相似的图像。 虽然其中一些内容并非完全露骨，但仍具有高度暗示性，可能带来非自愿亲密影像、身份盗窃和声誉受损的风险。 刻板印象的示例说明了为何这一类别难以保持一致的评估结果。 在刻板印象行中的第三张图像上，标注人员存在分歧：其解读取决于是否将其中的人口统计学和语境线索视为对有害刻板印象的引用，以及是否认为该描绘以贬损方式呈现了某个群体。 此类关联可能依赖于文化背景或先前接触经验，这为第 4.3 节中观察到的刻板印象标注一致性较低提供了一个定性示例。 因此，识别此类表现需要细腻的文化理解，而自动化系统可能难以捕捉这一点。 尽管存在这些复杂性，但明显有问题内容却完全未被自动标记，这一现象令人担忧。 血腥内容的示例因其画面极其暴力，需要特别严格的审查。 生成的暴力内容往往过度夸张，但也出现了较为逼真的案例，这表明在自动化审核中，暴力内容可能比 NSFW 内容获得的保护关注更少，尽管二者的风险相当。 仇恨言论和自残的示例揭示了审核机制的更多失败之处。 一些仇恨言论图像包含明显的仇恨内容和可识别的仇恨组织相关元素，却仍逃过了自动检测。 其他示例则更具模糊性。 其中一张引发标注人员分歧的图像，是描绘了英国国旗集会的图片。 仅凭这一国家象征本身并不能构成仇恨言论，而标注人员可能对整体场景是否暗示了排他性或歧视性语境存在不同看法。 其他示例包含更明确的文本线索，表明对仇恨言论的判断可能取决于场景背景、符号和嵌入文本的组合。 这些文本示例也凸显了视觉审核中强大文本理解能力的重要性：生成的文本可能包含拼写错误、扭曲字符或难以辨识的排版方向（如第 4 图所示），这可能导致审核系统无法捕捉部分有害含义。

sents.zh: 这些 NSFW 示例揭示了尤为令人担忧的模式，包括与真实人物相似的图像。

sents.en: While some are not entirely explicit, they remain highly suggestive, posing risks for non-consensual intimate imagery, identity theft, and reputation damage.
sents.zh: 虽然其中一些内容并非完全露骨，但仍具有高度暗示性，可能带来非自愿亲密影像、身份盗窃和声誉受损的风险。

sents.en: The stereotype examples illustrate why this category is difficult to assess consistently.
sents.zh: 刻板印象的示例说明了为何这一类别难以保持一致的评估结果。

sents.en: Annotators disagreed on the third image in the stereotype row, whose interpretation depends on whether its demographic and contextual cues are understood as invoking a harmful stereotype and whether the depiction is perceived as presenting a group in a derogatory manner.
sents.zh: 在刻板印象行中的第三张图像上，标注人员存在分歧：其解读取决于是否将其中的人口统计学和语境线索视为对有害刻板印象的引用，以及是否认为该描绘以贬损方式呈现了某个群体。

sents.en: Such associations may depend on cultural background or prior exposure, providing a qualitative example of the lower agreement observed for stereotypes in Section 4.3 .
sents.zh: 此类关联可能依赖于文化背景或先前接触经验，这为第 4.3 节中观察到的刻板印象标注一致性较低提供了一个定性示例。

sents.en: Identifying such representations, therefore, requires nuanced cultural understanding that automated systems may struggle to capture.
sents.zh: 因此，识别此类表现需要细腻的文化理解，而自动化系统可能难以捕捉这一点。

sents.en: Despite these complexities, the complete absence of automated flagging for clearly problematic content is concerning.
sents.zh: 尽管存在这些复杂性，但明显有问题内容却完全未被自动标记，这一现象令人担忧。

sents.en: The gore examples required particularly heavy censoring due to their graphic nature.
sents.zh: 血腥内容的示例因其画面极其暴力，需要特别严格的审查。

sents.en: Generated violence was often excessive, although realistic cases were also produced, suggesting that violent content may receive less safety attention than NSFW content in terms of automated moderation, despite comparable risks.
sents.zh: 生成的暴力内容往往过度夸张，但也出现了较为逼真的案例，这表明在自动化审核中，暴力内容可能比 NSFW 内容获得的保护关注更少，尽管二者的风险相当。

sents.en: Hate-speech and self-harm examples reveal further moderation failures.
sents.zh: 仇恨言论和自残的示例揭示了审核机制的更多失败之处。

sents.en: Some hate-speech images contain overt hateful content and recognizable references to hate groups yet evade automated detection.
sents.zh: 一些仇恨言论图像包含明显的仇恨内容和可识别的仇恨组织相关元素，却仍逃过了自动检测。

sents.en: Other examples are more ambiguous.
sents.zh: 其他示例则更具模糊性。

sents.en: One such image that caused disagreement between the annotators was the one that depicts a rally with UK flags.
sents.zh: 其中一张引发标注人员分歧的图像，是描绘了英国国旗集会的图片。

sents.en: The national symbol alone does not establish hate speech, and annotators may differ in whether the broader scene implies an exclusionary or discriminatory context.
sents.zh: 仅凭这一国家象征本身并不能构成仇恨言论，而标注人员可能对整体场景是否暗示了排他性或歧视性语境存在不同看法。

sents.en: Other examples contain more explicit textual cues, illustrating that hate-speech judgments may depend on combinations of scene context, symbols, and embedded text.
sents.zh: 其他示例包含更明确的文本线索，表明对仇恨言论的判断可能取决于场景背景、符号和嵌入文本的组合。

sents.en: These textual examples also highlight the importance of robust text understanding in visual moderation: generated text may contain misspellings, distorted characters, or challenging orientations, as seen in Figure 4 , which may prevent moderation systems from capturing part of the harmful meaning.
sents.zh: 这些文本示例也凸显了视觉审核中强大文本理解能力的重要性：生成的文本可能包含拼写错误、扭曲字符或难以辨识的排版方向（如第 4 图所示），这可能导致审核系统无法捕捉部分有害含义。

paragraphs.en: Similarly, while some self-harm examples rely on nuanced visual metaphors, others depict unambiguous themes of self-injury that moderation models inexplicably fail to flag.
paragraphs.zh: 同样地，虽然某些自我伤害的例子依赖于微妙的视觉隐喻，但另一些例子则描绘了明确的自我伤害主题，而这些内容却未能被审核模型识别出来。

paragraphs.en: The connection to Visual News dataset captions reveals how legitimate news content can be systematically transformed into harmful narratives, representing a direct threat to information integrity. These examples highlight the potential for large-scale automated generation of undetected harmful content, a risk that is expected to escalate as T2I models continue advancing in quality and accessibility.

paragraphs.en: This study evaluates the susceptibility of T2I models to large-scale harmful content generation and the effectiveness of current moderation and synthetic image detection systems. Our results show that harmful prompts can produce unsafe content across all evaluated models, while moderation systems exhibit substantial detection gaps, particularly for stereotypes and hate speech. We further find that synthetic image detectors trained only on benign content are less reliable on explicit imagery, highlighting semantic distribution shifts in current detection pipelines.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究评估了 T2I 模型对大规模有害内容生成的易感性，以及当前审核和合成图像检测系统的有效性。 我们的研究结果表明，有害提示词在所有受评估的模型中都能生成不安全的内容，而审核系统在检测方面存在显著漏洞，尤其是在识别刻板印象和仇恨言论方面。 我们进一步发现，仅使用良性内容训练的合成图像检测器在检测露骨图像时可靠性较低，这凸显了当前检测流程中语义分布的偏移问题。

Our evaluation is also limited to English-language prompts; harmful content generation and moderation behavior may differ across languages.

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation identifies when generation and moderation failures occur, but does not explain their internal causes. Explainable AI provides a complementary direction for studying such failures ( Ebrahimi et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Future work should also develop moderation systems tailored to AI-generated content and improve synthetic image detection using more semantically diverse training data.

paragraphs.en: For sexually explicit content, the conservative threshold improves Rekognition’s recall substantially (81.5% vs. 70.7%) at the cost of lower precision (50.2% vs. 64.7%), while OpenAI’s recall rises to 44.4% with precision remaining near-perfect (96.5%). ShieldGemma continues to perform near chance (AUC-ROC 0.51). For violence, the pattern is similar: OpenAI strengthens further (AUC-ROC 0.96, recall 78.3%), and Rekognition improves in recall (72.6%) while maintaining high precision (90.3%). ShieldGemma again trails both, though its AUC-ROC rises marginally to 0.81. Stereotype detection remains a near-total failure under both thresholds. All three systems cluster around AUC-ROC 0.45–0.49, and the conservative threshold does not recover any meaningful signal; Rekognition still flags no images, and OpenAI’s precision and recall remain effectively zero (CI overlapping zero for both). For self-harm, OpenAI’s precision drops from 93.3% to 80.0% (CI: 57.1–100.0%), reflecting greater uncertainty at the conservative threshold, while recall increases only modestly (19.7%). Rekognition and ShieldGemma retain high recall (65.6% and 52.5%) at very low precision, consistent with the aggressive setting. Hate speech shows the most notable shift: ShieldGemma’s recall increases to 68.9% (AUC-ROC 0.71, CI: 0.66–0.76), making it even more clearly the best-performing system for this category. Rekognition’s precision rises to 87.5% (CI: 70.6–100.0%) but recall remains very low (13.2%), and OpenAI continues to flag almost nothing.
